title: Quick-Fix Snappy Malaysian Dum Satay
description: A savory, snappy, and quick-fix Malaysian dish featuring dum and a hint of brandy. It's an easy and delicious flexitarian option for any meal time.
instructions: Heat a lazy Susan spinner over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of peanut oil to the spinner and swirl it around to coat the surface.
Add 6 dum pieces to the spinner and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is lightly browned.
Add 6 more dum pieces to the spinner and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon of brandy to the spinner and flambe the dum pieces until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Add 2 tablespoons of chili sauce, 1 tablespoon of ginger paste, 2 tablespoons of lime juice, and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce to the spinner and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water chestnuts and 1 cup of bean sprouts to the spinner and stir to combine.
Season with 1 tablespoon of sugar and stir to combine.
Transfer the dum pieces to a serving platter and garnish with 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, 1/2 cup of toasted peanuts, and 1/4 cup of fresh cilantro.
